notes: R5-1 (B-60c, CR 610.3): 'Exile that card until this creature leaves the battlefield.' Freebooter exiles Zap from seat 1's hand, then dies to 2 damage; the second one-shot effect returns Zap to its owner's hand (its previous zone). Before R5-1 the template dropped the until-clause and Zap stayed in exile forever (stronger than printed).
